title: Senior Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


SENIOR BRAND DESIGNER- MENLO PARK, CALIFORNIA

WHO WE ARE

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud — a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. Wherever data or users live, Snowflake delivers a single and seamless experience across multiple public clouds. Snowflake’s platform is the engine that powers and provides access to the AI Data Cloud, creating a platform for Data Engineering, Analytics, AI and Apps and Collaboration. Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud. snowflake.com


WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for a well-rounded Senior Brand Designer to join our Brand Design team, reporting into the Sr Manager, Corporate Design. You’ll create across a wide range of brand touchpoints–from events, tradeshows, and keynote presentations to eBooks, global campaigns, and product launches–while supporting the continued evolution of our core brand visual identity and assets.

You must be a self-starter with a can-do attitude. A designer who loves design exploration but also recognizes the realities of day-to-day work. You can manage your own projects in a timely manner, work with internal and external partners, and can present your work to stakeholders and explain your design thinking. You will create your work with a high attention to detail and craft.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design high-quality assets across a variety of media, including campaigns, events, web, presentations, and print

  • Work within the Brand Design team which is responsible for the creative and art direction of the company, deliver consistent brand design across digital, print, event, and presentation channels

  • Contribute to the expansion of our brand visual identity system, building and maintaining consistency across brand touchpoints

  • Collaborate with marketing, event, producers, production, content, motion and video teams to ensure cohesive brand expression and high-quality design outputs

  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously to ensure timely delivery

  • AI-Native Processes: Using Snowflake agentic AI products (CoCo, CoWork) conceptualize and build improvements and innovations within our workflows


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 7-10 years of brand/graphic design experience, ideally in mid-to-large tech and creative agency environments

  • Mastery of and continued learning for industry-standard applications, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, PowerPoint, and Google Slides

  • Strong understanding and experience in developing and working within evolving brand systems

  • Systems-thinking with a collaborative and open mindset, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-volume and fast-paced environment

  • Technical expertise preparing deliverables for digital, print, and large-scale formats

  • Ability to advocate for the work, including brief-building with stakeholders to define a project’s parameters, thoughtful discovery and problem-solving, and excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present work to diverse stakeholders

  • Portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft and versatility across formats (digital, social, print, event, keynote), with clarity on your role in each

  • Natural curiosity around AI tools and processes — you want to jump in to conceptualize and build AI processes that support creative exploration, accelerate workflows, and push visual innovation


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

  • 10-15 years in design with proven impact at scale—ideally a mix of mid-to-large tech and creative agency experience

  • Bonus points for basic animation skills (Figma animation, etc.)

  • Experience with Wrike, Canva or Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Art, Graphic Design, Marketing Communications, or related field (or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience)


LET’S DO THIS!

The Snowflake Brand & Creative team is a tight-knit, dynamic group of creators and makers who are responsible for shaping the future of the Snowflake brand. We’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. If you want to play a part in creating this global iconic brand, we want to hear from you!

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
